text:
mai: Heads-up — started onboarding sirocco-v1 into staging. Quick multilingual eval shows weird drops for vertical CJK items and an RTL bracket-order issue for Hebrew/Arabic samples. Any ideas?
arturo: Can you paste the numbers + what quant/config you used?
mai: Ran the standard multilingual harness: `./eval/run_suite.sh --model sirocco-v1 --suite multilingual-locale-2026 --quant q5_0 --detok standard`
mai: Output snippet:
```
overall: BLEU avg - baseline: 31.2 -> sirocco-v1: 29.1 (-2.1)
en->zh-Hant (vertical samples): BLEU 22.5 -> 19.8 (-2.7), chrF -3.1
he->en: BLEU 17.2 -> 14.9 (-2.3), bracket_flip_count: baseline=3, sirocco=46
token_mismatch_counts: zh-Hant-vertical: 412 mismatched subtokens vs baseline 8
```
hana: Whoa — that many mismatches for vertical zh is concerning. Did you try the non-quantized run?
mai: Yes, float32 run looks fine (within noise). Regression only appears after q5_0 compression and some kernel selection variants on the build we tested.
sean: Could be detokenizer or stray ZWJ/ZWSP handling interacting with the tokenizer map after quant. Any sample inputs/outputs?
mai: Sample (source is vertical text with ruby/furigana):
```
src: ︱學︱生︱（︱試︱）
ref: 學生（試）
out: （學生）試
```
mai: Notice parentheses got mirrored/relocated. For Hebrew sample:
```
src: שלום (עולם)
ref: שלום (עולם)
out: )עולם( שלום
```
eva: That looks like bidi reordering got applied at the wrong stage — detok or post-processing ordering probably using an API that assumes logical order vs visual order. Quant triggered a token alignment shift so detok heuristics mis-locate bracket tokens.
arturo: Run `--detok-mode=legacy` and `--bidi-normalize=false` as an A/B, and also dump token ids for affected samples: `python debug/dump_tokens.py --model sirocco-v1 --ids 1234,1235`
hana: Also try re-run with compiler flag `KERNEL_FALLBACK=1` — earlier we saw different kernel picks change tokenization boundary sensitivity for long furigana markers.
sean: Quick metric to add: edit-distance % (char) increased +0.7% on zh-Hant vertical set, but token alignment shift explains most of BLEU drop.
deploy-bot: model-deploy: sirocco-v1 staged rollout 10% (job 58212) at 5880004360 :rocket:
eva: Can we bisect between q5_0 builds? If float32 is fine and quant causes it, narrow to quant quantizer versions and kernel sets. I suspect a post-quant remap step that tries to merge rare subwords differently.
mai: I'll open a triage ticket and attach failing sample set + token dumps. Ticket TICKET-4672 created.
arturo: For immediate mitigation, can we pin staging to skip q5_0 variant for locales zh-Hant/he/ar until triage done?
mai: Yes, rolling that back now. Thanks all — will post updates in the ticket with diffs and token maps. :thumbsup:
